decay_policy: Revalidate OPENAI_STAFF_COMMUNITY after 30 days and COMMUNITY/REDDIT after 14 days before treating as current.

items.claim: Clear intended tool intent + model-written tool language + lots of routing evals/hill-climbing are among the few explicit staff recommendations for discovery/selection optimization.
items.action: Maintain tool-selection evals in CI; generate multiple description variants and select by measured precision/recall.

items.claim: Directory keyword search focused heavily on title/subtitle as of April 2026.
items.action: Use literal customer-facing names/subtitles that map to user intent, but do not keyword-stuff.

items.claim: Automatic/organic discovery has been immature and uneven; directory placement is not guaranteed distribution.
items.action: Treat ChatGPT distribution as upside, not your only acquisition channel; build direct deep-link/website distribution and make explicit @ invocation excellent.

items.claim: Auth and review flows are frequent failure points.
items.action: Delay auth until a user action truly requires it; offer read-only/no-auth discovery where possible; maintain reviewer fixture account.

items.claim: iframes/CSP/widget caching add disproportionate review/debug friction.
items.action: Default to tool-only or native lightweight widget; version widget URIs; no iframe unless essential.

items.claim: A tiny semantic tool surface is easier for models to select correctly than a provider-shaped API mirror.
items.action: Target 3-6 model-visible tools per vertical unless evals justify more; keep provider methods private.

items.claim: The durable moat should live in external reality (authorized provider graph, normalized schema, quotes, availability, quality/reliability observations), not in generic orchestration ChatGPT can reproduce.
items.action: Own provider adapters/data/standards; let ChatGPT own reasoning and conversational workflow.

items.claim: Review requirements and infrastructure can change faster than review cycles.
items.action: Keep MCP schemas stable; change provider routing behind stable contracts; re-fetch docs on submission day.
